summary.text: David Luneau is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack 9 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business executive and co-founder of ClassCo Inc., he has served in the House since 2014.

paragraphs.text: David Luneau lives in Hopkinton, New Hampshire, and graduated from Hopkinton High School.
He earned a degree in electrical engineering and computer science from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 1987.
His career experience includes co-founding ClassCo Inc. and working as its president, and he has served as president of the Hopkinton Rotary Club and chair of the Hopkinton School Board.
Luneau was elected to the New Hampshire House in 2014 as an independent and later changed his party affiliation to the Democratic Party.
He served on the House Education Committee in 2019-2020 as vice chair and in 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 as a member.
